description: This file defines a ReportRepository class that provides various reporting and analytics functions for a financial app. It performs SQL queries on a local database to generate summaries such as totals in a date range, category breakdowns, weekly trends, monthly summaries, and quick totals, based on transactions and categories stored in the database.

classes.name: ReportRepository
classes.description: A singleton class that provides methods for generating various financial reports and summaries using SQL queries.

methods.name: totalsInRange
methods.description: Calculates total income and expense within a specified date range using SQL aggregations and join.

methods.name: categoryBreakdown
methods.description: Returns breakdown of spendings by categories within a date range.

methods.name: weeklyTrend
methods.description: Generates weekly trend data over a date range, aggregating income and expense per week.

methods.name: monthlySummary
methods.description: Provides monthly summaries (income and expense totals) within a date range.

methods.name: quickTotals
methods.description: Returns immediate total income, expense, and net for a date range without additional models.
